verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents GEMINI.md custom context files for tailoring behavior/project conventions (gemini-cli-gh-9) and docs mention /memory command for managing this context (gemini-cli-docs-3). However, hands-on community feedback reports the file being ignored despite being loaded ('it consistently ignores my GEMINI.md file, both global and local, even though it always says 1 GEMINI.md file is being used' - gemini-cli-comm-13), directly contradicting reliable adherence to project instructions. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that GEMINI.md is consistently honored, more detail on precedence/hierarchy of instruction files, and resolution of the reported ignoring behavior.
